name: Astra.
source:
Astra. is a visual novel game about Astra, a star child, who falls on a planet. She meets the sole inhabitant, Misha, an intelligent lifeform who's not exactly friendly. The player must navigate Astra's choices to avoid a bad end.

[From [url=https://mxedk.itch.io/astra]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Astra.》是一部视觉小说游戏，讲述星之子阿斯特拉坠落到一颗星球。她遇见唯一的居民米莎——一种并不友善的智慧生命体。玩家必须引导阿斯特拉作出选择，避免坏结局。

[来源：[url=https://mxedk.itch.io/astra]itch.io[/url]]
